speaker: Doctor
text: Please describe exactly how the swelling in your right knee started and what activities were you doing at the time? Also, could you tell me more about your family history of similar joint problems?

speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia B (Factor IX deficiency).

I note the patient's age, the spontaneous nature of the swelling after minor activity, and the specific family history involving an uncle. This strongly suggests a bleeding disorder rather than a traumatic or infectious cause. To confirm this, I must see the lab results for your clotting factors immediately.

REQUEST TEST: Coagulation_Panel (PT, PTT, Factor_IX_level)
REQUEST IMAGES: Right_Knee_Ultrasound
